newsitem.title: USA: Demeter compound reduces tumors in mice.
newsitem.headline: Demeter compound reduces tumors in mice.

text.p: Demeter BioTechnologies Ltd said Wednesday that its lead anti-cancer Peptidyl Membrane Interactive Molecule caused significant tumor reduction in a prostate cancer mouse model.
Demeter said that in earlier studies, Peptidyl MIMs had demonstrated significant in vitro efficacy against numerous cancer cell lines, while causing minimal toxicity to healthy cells.

The company said that the results demonstrated no significant reduction of the tumor in the Control group or in the group receiving the lowest dose of Peptidyl MIM, but there was significant tumor reduction achieved in the groups of mice which received the three higher doses.
According to Demeter, there was complete tumor regression in nearly all of the mice with the two highest doses of Peptidyl MIM.
The company said that considerable pre-clinical testing will need to be completed before human clinical trials can be initiated.
